headline.en: Find a subject identifier across your configured stores.
headline.zh: 在配置的存储中定位主体标识。

sub.en: SubjectPurge scans registered stores for an explicit subject identifier and collects matching locations into a structured residue map.
sub.zh: SubjectPurge 在登记存储中扫描明确主体标识，将匹配位置汇总为结构化残留地图。

body.en: Configured adapters share a locate interface.
body.zh: 配置适配器共用 locate 接口。

body.en: Each hit carries a store locator and evidence hash.
body.zh: 每个命中携带存储位置与证据哈希。

body.en: The current scan produces a reviewable location map.
body.zh: 当前扫描生成可检查的位置地图。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Create temporary SQLite and trace inputs containing demo@example.com, locate matches, and confirm the database still has both original rows.
note.zh: 创建含 demo@example.com 的临时 SQLite 与轨迹输入，定位匹配，并确认数据库仍保留两条原始记录。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Read-only matching of a reserved example email in temporary SQLite and text stores; no personal data, Chroma scan, deletion or audit proof.

body.en: Create temporary SQLite and trace inputs containing demo@example.com, locate matches, and confirm the database still has both original rows.
body.zh: 创建含 demo@example.com 的临时 SQLite 与轨迹输入，定位匹配，并确认数据库仍保留两条原始记录。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/subjectpurge.git
cd subjectpurge
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: purge, audit and verify are unimplemented milestones. The current release locates references but does not delete them or issue a signed audit proof.
limitations.zh: purge、audit 与 verify 尚未实现。当前版本定位引用，不删除数据，也不签发审计证明。

limitations.en: Exact identifier matching can miss paraphrases or transformed identifiers. A scan cannot establish that every personal-data residue has been found.
limitations.zh: 精确标识匹配可能漏掉改写或变换后的标识；扫描不能证明已找到全部个人数据残留。

limitations.en: The demo only uses temporary SQLite and text files with a reserved example email. No live store is accessed.
limitations.zh: 示例只使用临时 SQLite、文本文件及保留示例邮箱，不访问在线存储。

body.en: A contact identifier can appear in a note row and a trace line. One store registry lets an operator locate those references together before deciding what a deletion workflow must handle.
body.zh: 联系标识可能同时出现在笔记行和轨迹行。一份存储登记表让操作者先集中定位这些引用，再确定删除流程需要处理什么。

body.en: StoreConfig constructs a supported adapter for each entry. Scanner calls locate, collects ResidueHit objects and closes adapters. Hits retain store, locator, match category and evidence hash; write_residue_map serializes the result.
body.zh: StoreConfig 为每个条目创建支持的适配器。Scanner 调用 locate、收集 ResidueHit 并关闭适配器。命中保留存储、定位、类别与证据哈希，write_residue_map 将结果序列化。

body.en: StoreConfig constructs a supported adapter for each entry. Scanner calls locate, collects ResidueHit objects and closes adapters. Hits retain store, locator, match category and evidence hash; write_residue_map serializes the result.
body.zh: StoreConfig 为每个条目创建支持的适配器。Scanner 调用 locate、收集 ResidueHit 并关闭适配器。命中保留存储、定位、类别与证据哈希，write_residue_map 将结果序列化。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: stores.yaml lists id, kind, path or glob and adapter settings. SQLite uses table and text_columns; Chroma uses collection and requires the optional chroma extra. graph is declared in the schema but no built-in adapter is registered. operator and law_ref are metadata, not compliance validation.
body.zh: stores.yaml 列出 id、kind、path 或 glob 与适配设置。SQLite 使用 table 和 text_columns；Chroma 使用 collection 并需要可选 chroma 依赖。schema 声明 graph，但未注册内置适配器。operator 与 law_ref 是元数据，不执行合规验证。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。
